package.description: Brosix is an Instant Messaging Software for Businesses, providing encrypted, real-time communications, across multiple applications, to streamline how day-to-day business gets done.

en-US.description: Brosix is an Instant Messaging Software for Businesses, providing encrypted, real-time communications, across multiple applications, to streamline how day-to-day business gets done.
en-US.longDescription:
Brosix is an Instant Messaging Software for Businesses, providing encrypted, real-time communications, across multiple applications, to streamline how day-to-day business gets done.
No more messaging over insecure applications. No more down time, waiting for time-sensitive information. Secure, instantaneous chats, meetings, and team collaboration that are easily archived and retrievable. No more endless searching for past communiqués.
See https://www.brosix.com/features/ for more.
en-US.name: Brosix

zh-CN.description: Brosix 是一款面向企业的即时通讯软件，提供跨多个应用程序的加密实时通讯，以简化日常业务的完成方式。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Brosix 是一款面向企业的即时通讯软件，提供跨多个应用程序的加密实时通讯，以简化日常业务的完成方式。
不再通过不安全的应用程序发送信息。不再有等待时效性信息的停机时间。安全、即时的聊天、会议和团队协作可轻松存档和检索。再也不用无休止地搜索过去的公报了。
有关更多功能介绍，请见 https://www.brosix.com/features/。
zh-CN.name: Brosix for Windows
